slots.STAT_SUB: Adults with high blood pressure don't know it yet.
slots.GIFT_BODY: One press on her wrist. Her numbers reach your phone — wherever you are.

1a.title: 6 in 10
1a.caption: Nearly six in ten Nigerian adults with high blood pressure don't know it — because there's usually nothing to feel. A reading is the only way to find out, and Leiko checks yours in about thirty seconds, right on your wrist. Know the number, not just the guess. leiko.health

sources.name: Hypertension country profile — Nigeria (WHO, 2023)
sources.figure: WHO 2023 Nigeria hypertension country profile: 47% prevalence among ages 30-79 (19.1M adults); 42% diagnosed; 51% of those diagnosed treated; 27% controlled. That leaves roughly 58% (about 6 in 10) not yet aware.

1b.title: My doctor would have caught it
1b.caption: Plenty of us assume a doctor would catch high blood pressure on a routine visit. But numbers shift day to day, and only three in ten Nigerians with high blood pressure have theirs under control. Checking often — not just once — is what actually catches it. leiko.health

sources.name: Hypertension country profile — Nigeria (WHO, 2023)
sources.figure: 27% of Nigerian adults with hypertension have their blood pressure under control, per WHO's 2023 country profile.

1c.title: Check on Mama
1c.caption: If Mama lives far from you, her blood pressure doesn't have to be a mystery. She wears it, presses once, and her reading reaches your phone — wherever you are. A small way to check on her, often. leiko.health
